def: A post-training recipe that trains domain specialist teachers, for example for math, code or agents, with SFT and RL, then distills them into one student with on-policy distillation.
practice: Xiaomi's MiMo-V2-Flash report (January 2026) first documented it; NVIDIA's Nemotron 3 Ultra and Zhipu's GLM-5 also use it, though labs are not unanimous, as of November 2026.
